paragraphs: The Granadine Confederation (Spanish: Confederación Granadina) was a short-lived federal republic established in 1858 as a result of a constitutional change replacing the Republic of New Granada. It consisted of the present-day nations of Colombia and Panama and parts of northwestern Brazil. In turn, the Granadine Confederation was replaced by the United States of Colombia after another constitutional change in 1863.

Huanca.headline: Huanca
paragraphs: Huanca (tudi Wanca ali Wanka) so kečuansko ljudstvo v regiji Junín v osrednjem Peruju, v dolini reke Mantaro in njeni okolici.

source.title: Huanca
paragraphs: The Huancas, Wancas, or Wankas are a Quechua people living in the Junín Region of central Peru, in and around the Mantaro Valley.

Huastec civilization.headline: Huasteška civilizacija
paragraphs: Huasteška civilizacija (pisana tudi Huaxtec ali Wastek) je bila predkolumbovska civilizacija Mezoamerike na mehiški zalivski obali, na ozemlju, ki je obsegalo severni del zvezne države Veracruz in sosednja območja zveznih držav Hidalgo, Querétaro, San Luis Potosí in Tamaulipas. Huasteki so bili zgodnja veja majevskih ljudstev, ki se je preselila proti severu.

Med ohranjenimi ostanki huasteške civilizacije je več velikih arheoloških najdišč, dobro ohranjen tempelj in veliko kamnitih kipov. Do poznega postklasičnega obdobja (ok. 1200–1521 n. št.) so Huasteki razvili metalurgijo in izdelovali bakrove zlitine. Azteški imperij je huasteško pokrajino osvojil okoli 15. stoletja in od nje verjetno zahteval davek.

source.title: Huastec civilization
paragraphs: The Huastec civilization (sometimes spelled Huaxtec or Wastek) was a pre-Columbian civilization of Mesoamerica, occupying a territory on the Gulf coast of Mexico that included the northern portion of Veracruz state, and neighbouring regions of the states of Hidalgo, Querétaro, San Luis Potosí, and Tamaulipas. The Huastec people were an early offshoot of the Maya peoples that migrated northwards.

Surviving remains from the Huastec civilization include several large archaeological sites, a well-preserved temple, and a large amount of stone sculpture. By the Late Postclassic (c. AD 1200–1521), the Huastecs had developed metallurgy and were producing copper alloys. The Aztec Empire conquered the Huastec region around the 15th century, and probably demanded tribute payments.

Ichma culture.headline: Kultura Ichma
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Ichma (pisano tudi Ychma, Yschma, Ishma in drugače; v klasični kečuanščini ićhma, dobesedno »cinober«) ali kraljestvo Pachacamac je bila predinkovska domorodna politična skupnost, ki jo je pozneje vsrkal Inkovski imperij in jo preoblikoval v provinco (wanami). Inki so jo poznali kot Pachakamaq (Pachacamac), ne s prvotnim imenom Ichma.

Kraljestvo je ležalo južno od Lime v Peruju, v dolini reke Lurín, pozneje pa se je razširilo na sever v dolino reke Rímac. Kultura Ishma je nastala okoli leta 1100 n. št., po razpadu imperija Wari, samostojnost pa je ohranila do okoli leta 1469, ko jo je vsrkal Inkovski imperij.

Čeprav so prebivalci kraljestva živeli v puščavi, so imeli visok življenjski standard, saj so znali speljati številne namakalne kanale, kamor koli je segala rečna voda, in tako ohranjati obsežne sadovnjake in gozd.
notes: The pronunciation in IPA is left out.

source.title: Ichma culture
paragraphs: The Ichma kingdom (also written Ychma or Yschma, Ishma, among other spellings; Classical Quechua: ićhma, pronounced [ˈiʈʂ.ma], lit. 'vermillion') or Pachacamac kingdom was a pre-Inca indigenous polity later absorbed by the Inca Empire and reorganized as a wanami (province). For the Inca it was known as Pachakamaq (Pachacamac), rather than its original name of Ichma.

The Ichmay Kingdom was located south of Lima, Peru in the Lurín River valley; it later spread north into the Rímac River's valley. The Ishma culture was formed around 1100 AD following the breakup of the Wari Empire. Ishma autonomy lasted until around 1469 when they were absorbed into the Incan Empire.

Despite occupying a desert, the inhabitants of Ishma had a high standard of living, thanks to their expertise in devising multiple irrigation channels as far as the river waters could reach, to give life to an extensive orchard and forest.

Itza people.headline: Itzaji
paragraphs: Itzaji so majevska etnična skupina, potomci ljudstva Chanes iz pokrajine Chontal v Tabascu. V 10. stoletju so se preselili v Bacalar in na sever Jukatana, pozneje prišli v Champotón, v 15. stoletju pa so se naselili ob jezeru Petén Itzá, kjer so ostali neodvisni do leta 1697. V španskem kolonialnem obdobju in pozneje pod gvatemalsko vlado so bili žrtve zatiralne politike, ki je pospešila izumiranje njihove kulture in jezika, zato so izgubili velik del etnične identitete.

So ena najmanjših majevskih skupin z najmanj pripadniki: redki potomci živijo v kraju San José severno od jezera Petén Itzá v departmaju Petén v Gvatemali in so se močno prilagodili mestiški družbi, jezik kot materni govori le še 36 starejših ljudi.

source.title: Itza people
paragraphs: The Itza are a Maya ethnic group. They are descendants of the Chanes from the Chontal region of Tabasco. They migrated to Bacalar and northern Yucatán during the 10th century, later arriving to Champotón and finally in the 15th century settling around Lake Petén Itzá where they remained independent until 1697. During the Spanish colonial era and later by the Guatemalan government, the Itza were victims of repressive policies that accelerated the extinction of the Itza culture and language, leading to the loss of much of their ethnic identity.

They are one of the smallest Maya groups and have the lowest population; the few Itza descendants are settled in the town of San José, north of Lake Petén Itzá in the department of Petén, Guatemala, and are considered highly acculturated to mestizo society, with only 36 elderly people remaining as native speakers of the language.

Jesuit missions among the Guaraní.headline: Jezuitski misijoni med Gvarani
paragraphs: Jezuitski misijoni med Gvarani so bili naselbine za ljudstvo Gvarani (»Indijance« ali »Indios«) na območju ob meji današnje Argentine, Brazilije in Paragvaja, ki ga domačini imenujejo tromeja. Misijone je v začetku 17. stoletja ustanovil jezuitski red katoliške cerkve, končali pa so se konec 18. stoletja, ko so red izgnali iz Amerik. Nekateri jih označujejo za poskus »socialistične teokracije« ali za redek primer »benignega kolonializma«. Drugi pravijo, da so »jezuiti Indijancem vzeli svobodo, jih prisilili v korenito spremembo načina življenja, jih telesno zlorabljali in izpostavili boleznim«.

Španski in Portugalski imperij sta v na novo pridobljenih južnoameriških posestih domorodno prebivalstvo zbirala v skupnosti, imenovane »indijanske redukcije« (špansko: reducciones de indios, portugalsko: reduções). Njihov namen je bil širiti krščanstvo in evropsko kulturo. Redukcije so ustanavljale tako posvetne kot cerkvene oblasti.

source.title: Jesuit missions among the Guaraní
paragraphs: The Jesuit missions among the Guaraní were a type of settlement for the Guaraní people ("Indians" or "Indios") in an area straddling the borders of present-day Argentina, Brazil and Paraguay, known locally as the triple frontier. The missions were established by the Jesuit Order of the Catholic Church early in the 17th century and ended in the late 18th century after the expulsion of the order from the Americas. The missions have been called an experiment in "socialist theocracy" or a rare example of "benign colonialism". Others have said that "the Jesuits took away the Indians' freedom, forced them to radically change their lifestyle, physically abused them, and subjected them to disease".

In their newly acquired South American dominions, the Spanish and Portuguese Empires adopted a strategy of gathering native populations into communities called "Indian reductions" (Spanish: reducciones de indios, Portuguese: reduções). The objectives of the reductions were to impart Christianity and European culture. Secular as well as religious authorities created "reductions".

Kansas City Hopewell.headline: Hopewell iz Kansas Cityja
paragraphs: Hopewell iz Kansas Cityja je bila najzahodnejša regionalna različica hopewellske tradicije srednjega gozdnega obdobja (100 pr. n. št.–700 n. št.). Njena najdišča so ležala v Kansasu in Missouriju okoli ustja reke Kansas v Missouri. Zabeleženih je 30 najdišč.

Zanje so značilni posebni slogi lončenine in mogočne grobne gomile s kamnitimi obokanimi grobnicami. Ni pa jasno, ali se je kultura razvila na kraju samem, ko so ljudje prevzeli hopewellske značilnosti, ali so jo v celoti prinesli hopewellski priseljenci z vzhoda.

source.title: Kansas City Hopewell
paragraphs: The Kansas City Hopewell were the farthest west regional variation of the Hopewell tradition of the Middle Woodland period (100 BCE – 700 CE). Sites were located in Kansas and Missouri around the mouth of the Kansas River where it enters the Missouri River. There are 30 recorded Kansas City Hopewell sites.

The sites are made up of distinctive pottery styles and impressive burial mounds containing stone vault tombs. It is however uncertain whether this culture developed locally when people adopted Hopewell traits, or if westward migrating Hopewell people brought it all with them.

Kingdom of Nicoya.headline: Kraljestvo Nicoya
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Nicoya (iz nahuatla: Nekok Yaotl), imenovano tudi kacikat ali gospostvo Nicoya, je bila domorodna skupnost, ki je obsegala večino ozemlja današnje province Guanacaste na severnem pacifiškem delu Kostarike. Njeno politično, gospodarsko in versko središče je bilo mesto Nicoya na istoimenskem polotoku, ki so mu bile podrejene številne pokrajine na obeh bregovih zaliva Nicoya in mnoge vasi, ki so mu plačevale davek. V 16. stoletju, pred prihodom Evropejcev, je bila Nicoya najpomembnejše poglavarstvo na severnem pacifiškem delu današnje Kostarike.

source.title: Kingdom of Nicoya
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Nicoya (from Nahuatl: Nekok Yaotl), also called Cacicazgo or Lordship of Nicoya, was an indigenous nation that comprised much of the territory of the current Guanacaste Province, in the North Pacific of Costa Rica. Its political, economic and religious center was the city of Nicoya, located on the peninsula of the same name, which depends on several provinces located on both banks of the Gulf of Nicoya, as well as numerous tributary villages. In the 16th century, prior to the arrival of Europeans, Nicoya was the most important chiefdom of the North Pacific of present-day Costa Rica.

Kolomoki Mounds.headline: Gomile Kolomoki
paragraphs: Gomile Kolomoki so eden največjih in najzgodnejših kompleksov zemeljskih gomil gozdnega obdobja na jugovzhodu Združenih držav in največji v Georgii. Zgradili so jih med letoma 350 in 600 n. št.; kompleks leži na jugozahodu Georgie, v današnjem okrožju Early blizu reke Chattahoochee.
Leta 1964 so gomile razglasili za nacionalni zgodovinski spomenik. Sedem od osmih gomil je zaščitenih v državnem zgodovinskem parku Kolomoki Mounds.

source.title: Kolomoki Mounds
paragraphs: The Kolomoki Mounds is one of the largest and earliest Woodland period earthwork mound complexes in the Southeastern United States and is the largest in Georgia. Constructed from 350 to 600 CE, the mound complex is located in southwest Georgia, in present-day Early County near the Chattahoochee River.
The mounds were designated as a National Historic Landmark in 1964. Seven of the eight mounds are protected as part of Kolomoki Mounds State Historic Park.

Lamar mounds and village site.headline: Gomile in vas Lamar
paragraphs: Najdišče gomil in vasi Lamar (9BI2) je pomembno arheološko najdišče na bregovih reke Ocmulgee v okrožju Bibb v ameriški zvezni državi Georgia, nekaj milj jugovzhodno od najdišča gomil Ocmulgee. Obe najdišči sta del nacionalnega zgodovinskega parka Ocmulgee Mounds, narodnega parka in zgodovinskega okrožja, ki so ga ustanovili leta 1936 in ga upravlja ameriška služba narodnih parkov. Zgodovinarji in arheologi domnevajo, da je tu stala glavna vas ljudstva Ichisi, na katero je leta 1539 naletela odprava Hernanda de Sota.

source.title: Lamar mounds and village site
paragraphs: The Lamar mounds and village site (9BI2) is an important archaeological site on the banks of the Ocmulgee River in Bibb County, Georgia (U.S. state), several miles to the southeast of the Ocmulgee mound site. Both mound sites are part of the Ocmulgee Mounds National Historical Park, a national park and historic district created in 1936 and run by the U.S. National Park Service. Historians and archaeologists have theorized that the site is the location of the main village of the Ichisi encountered by the Hernando de Soto expedition in 1539.

Las Ánimas complex.headline: Kompleks Las Ánimas
paragraphs: Kompleks Las Ánimas je arheološka kultura severnega Čila, ki velja za neposredno predhodnico kulture Diaguita. Razvila se je med letoma 800 in 1000 n. št. v čilski pokrajini Norte Chico. Pred njo je na tem območju od leta 300 do 700 n. št. obstajala arheološka kultura, imenovana kompleks El Molle.

source.title: Las Ánimas complex
paragraphs: Las Ánimas complex is an archaeological culture of northern Chile considered to be the immediate precursor to the Diaguita culture. The culture developed in the Chilean region of Norte Chico between 800 and 1000 CE. Prior to Las Ánimas complex, an archaeological culture known as El Molle complex existed in Norte Chico from 300 to 700 CE.

Laurel complex.headline: Kompleks Laurel
paragraphs: Kompleks ali tradicija Laurel je arheološka kultura, ki je bila navzoča na območju današnjega južnega Quebeca, južnega in severozahodnega Ontaria ter vzhodne osrednje Manitobe v Kanadi ter severnega Michigana, severozahodnega Wisconsina in severne Minnesote v Združenih državah. Njeni nosilci so bili prvo ljudstvo v Ontariu severno od plovne poti Trent–Severn, ki je uporabljalo lončenino. Kompleks je dobil ime po nekdanjem naselju Laurel v Minnesoti, prvi pa ga je leta 1941 opredelil Lloyd Wilford.

source.title: Laurel complex
paragraphs: The Laurel complex or Laurel tradition is an archaeological culture which was present in what is now southern Quebec, southern and northwestern Ontario and east-central Manitoba in Canada, and northern Michigan, northwestern Wisconsin, and northern Minnesota in the United States. They were the first pottery using people of Ontario north of the Trent–Severn Waterway. The complex is named after the former unincorporated community of Laurel, Minnesota. It was first defined by Lloyd Wilford in 1941.

Lauricocha culture.headline: Kultura Lauricocha
paragraphs: Kultura Lauricocha je andsko predkeramično zaporedje v osrednjem Peruju, ki obsega približno 5000 let, od ok. 8000 do 2500 pr. n. št. Tipsko najdišče je jama Lauricocha, ki so jo odkrili leta 1957 na nadmorski višini več kot 4000 m blizu jezera Lauricocha. V njej so bili človeški ostanki, najstarejši doslej najdeni v Peruju, ki segajo v zadnjo ledeno dobo, pred ok. 9500 leti.

Celotno prazgodovinsko zaporedje v Peruju obsega 15.000 let: začne se okoli leta 13.000 pr. n. št., ko so prve družbe nabiralcev in lovcev pustile sledi v visokogorju Ayacucha in Ancasha. To so bila ljudstva, ki so se s severnoameriške celine prek Srednje Amerike selila proti jugu in poselila Ande. Sledi teh zgodnjih skupin so našli v skalnih jamah Lauricocha, Pacaicasa in Guitarrero.

source.title: Lauricocha culture
paragraphs: The Lauricocha culture is an Andean preceramic sequence in central Peru, spanning approximately 5,000 years from c. 8000 to 2500 BC. Its type culture is the Lauricocha Cave, discovered in 1957 at an altitude of over 4000 m near Lauricocha Lake. It contained human remains, the oldest found in Peru, which can be dated back to the last glacial period, c. 9,500 years ago.

The total prehistoric sequence in Peru spans 15,000 years, starting at about 13,000 BC when the first gatherer-hunter societies left their traces in the Ayacucho and Ancash highlands. These were populations that were migrating from the North American continent through Central America and populated the Andes. Traces of these early groups have been found in rock caves of Lauricocha, Pacaicasa and Guitarrero.

Leon-Jefferson culture.headline: Kultura Leon-Jefferson
paragraphs: Kultura Leon-Jefferson je izraz, s katerim arheologi označujejo protozgodovinsko indijansko arheološko kulturo, ki je približno od leta 1500 do 1704 n. št. cvetela na jugovzhodu Severne Amerike in jo povezujejo z zgodovinskim ljudstvom Apalachee. Živela je na območju današnjih okrožij Leon in Jefferson na severu Floride na jugovzhodu Združenih držav in po njih dobila ime.

source.title: Leon-Jefferson culture
paragraphs: The Leon-Jefferson Culture is the term used by archaeologists for a protohistoric Native American archaeological culture that flourished in southeastern North America from approximately 1500–1704 CE and is associated with the historic Apalachee people. It was located in and named for the present day Leon and Jefferson counties in northern Florida of the Southeastern United States

Lima culture.headline: Kultura Lima
paragraphs: Kultura Lima je bila domorodna civilizacija na območju današnje Lime v Peruju v zgodnjem vmesnem obdobju, približno od leta 100 do 650. Ta predinkovska kultura, ki se prekriva s sosednjimi civilizacijami Paracas, Moche in Nazca, je živela v puščavskem obalnem pasu Peruja, v dolinah rek Chillón, Rimac in Lurín. Od sosednjih kultur jo je težko ločiti, saj leži blizu drugih, bolje dokumentiranih kultur perujske obale, časovno pa je z njimi tesno povezana, če se z njimi celo ne prekriva. Zato kultura Lima ostaja precej nejasna in o njej je treba še veliko izvedeti.

source.title: Lima culture
paragraphs: The Lima culture was an indigenous civilization which existed in modern-day Lima, Peru during the Early Intermediate Period, extending from roughly 100 to 650. This pre-Incan culture, which overlaps with surrounding Paracas, Moche, and Nazca civilizations, was located in the desert coastal strip of Peru in the Chillon, Rimac and Lurin River valleys. It can be difficult to differentiate the Lima culture from surrounding cultures due to both its physical proximity to other, and better documented cultures, in Coastal Peru, and because it is chronologically very close, if not over lapped, by these other cultures as well. These factors all help contribute to the obscurity of the Lima culture, of which much information is still left to be learned.

Lucayan people.headline: Lukajci
paragraphs: Lukajci so bili domorodno ljudstvo Bahamov ter otokov Turks in Caicos pred evropsko kolonizacijo Amerik. Po mnenju nekaterih raziskovalcev, med njimi Juliana Granberryja in Garyja Vesceliusa, so bili veja Tainov, ki so poseljevali večino Karibov in Bahamov. Drugi raziskovalci, med njimi L. Antonio Curet, jih med Taine ne uvrščajo. Lukajci so bili prvi ameriški staroselci, s katerimi se je (oktobra 1492) srečal Krištof Kolumb. Kmalu po stiku so jih Španci začeli ugrabljati in zasužnjevati ter jih do leta 1520 z Bahamov povsem iztrebili.

Ime »Lucayan« je poangleščena oblika španskega Lucayos, ta pa je pošpanjena oblika lukajskega imena Lukku-Cairi, s katerim so se imenovali sami in ki pomeni »ljudje z otokov«. Lukajska beseda za otok, cairi, se je v španščini spremenila v cayo, v angleščini pa v cay (v ameriški angleščini pisano »key«).
notes: Lukajci is the form chosen for the Lucayans; worth a reviewer's check.

source.title: Lucayan people
paragraphs: The Lucayan people ( loo-KY-ən) were the Indigenous people of the Bahamas and the Turks and Caicos Islands before the European colonisation of the Americas. According to some scholars, including Julian Granberry and Gary Vescelius, they were a branch of the Taínos who inhabited most of the Caribbean and the Bahamas. Other scholars, including L. Antonio Curet, do not classify Lucayans as Taínos. The Lucayans were the first Indigenous Americans encountered by Christopher Columbus (in October 1492). Shortly after contact, the Spanish kidnapped and enslaved Lucayans with the displacement culminating in the complete eradication of the Lucayan people from the Bahamas by 1520.

The name "Lucayan" is an Anglicization of the Spanish Lucayos, itself a hispanicization derived from the Lucayan Lukku-Cairi, which the people used for themselves, meaning "people of the islands". The Lucayan word for "island", cairi, became cayo in Spanish and "cay" in English [spelled "key" in American English].

Lupaca.headline: Lupaca
paragraphs: Lupaca, Lupaka ali Lupaqa so bili ena od vej prednikov Ajmarov. Več stoletij so živeli blizu jezera Titicaca v Peruju, njihova zemlja pa je morda segala tudi v Bolivijo. Po propadu Tiahunaškega imperija v 11. stoletju so Lupake in druga ajmarska ljudstva ustanovili mogočna kraljestva. Sredi 15. stoletja jih je osvojil Inkovski imperij, v 1530. letih pa so prišli pod oblast Španskega imperija.

Rezidenca predinkovskih kraljev Lupake je bila verjetno na današnjem arheološkem najdišču Cutimbo. Glavno mesto inkovske province je bil Chucuito, danes istoimenska vas, kjer leži arheološko najdišče Inca Uyu.

source.title: Lupaca
paragraphs: The Lupaca, Lupaka, or Lupaqa people were one of the divisions of the ancestral Aymaras. The Lupaca lived for many centuries near Lake Titicaca in Peru and their lands possibly extended into Bolivia. The Lupacas and other Aymara peoples formed powerful kingdoms after the collapse of the Tiwanaku Empire in the 11th century. In the mid 15th century they were conquered by the Inca Empire and in the 1530s came under the control of the Spanish Empire.

The residence of the pre-Inca kings of Lupaca was probably what is today the archaeological site of Cutimbo. The capital of the Inca province was Chucuito, presently a village of the same name where the archaeological site of Inca Uyu is located.

Machalilla culture.headline: Kultura Machalilla
paragraphs: Machalilla so bili prazgodovinsko ljudstvo v Ekvadorju, na jugu province Manabí in na polotoku Santa Elena. Kdaj je kultura cvetela, ni zanesljivo, a običajno velja, da je trajala od leta 1500 do 1100 pr. n. št.

source.title: Machalilla culture
paragraphs: The Machalilla were a prehistoric people in Ecuador, in southern Manabí and the Santa Elena Peninsula. The dates when the culture thrived are uncertain, but are generally agreed to encompass 1500 BCE to 1100 BCE.

Manasota culture.headline: Kultura Manasota
paragraphs: Kultura Manasota je bila arheološka kultura na osrednji zalivski obali polotoka Florida, ki je trajala približno od leta 500 pr. n. št. do okoli leta 900, ko se je razvila v kulturo Safety Harbor. Približno od leta 300 do 700 je prevzela obredno keramiko in pogrebne navade kultur Weeden Island s severa Floride ter sosednje Alabame in Georgie.

Kulturo Manasota sta leta 1979 opredelila arheologa George Luer in Marion Almy. Njuna opredelitev je delno nadomestila starejšo opredelitev tradicije ali kulture Perico Island, ki se v poznejših raziskavah ni obnesla. Luer in Almy kulturi Manasota pripisujeta 25 arheoloških najdišč okoli zaliva Tampa ter med zalivom Tampa in zalivom Charlotte Harbor.

source.title: Manasota culture
paragraphs: The Manasota culture was an archaeological culture that was practiced on the central Gulf coast of the Florida peninsula from about 500 BCE until about 900, when it developed into the Safety Harbor culture. From about 300 to 700 the Manasota culture adopted the ceremonial ceramics and burial practices of the Weeden Island cultures of northern Florida and adjacent Alabama and Georgia.

The Manasota culture was defined by archaeologists George Luer and Marion Almy in 1979. Their definition partially replaced an earlier definition of a Perico Island tradition or culture, which failed to hold up under later research. Luer and Almy identify 25 archaeological sites around Tampa Bay and between Tampa Bay and Charlotte Harbor as belonging to the Manasota culture.

Mangue people.headline: Ljudstvo Mangue
paragraphs: Mangue, znani tudi kot Chorotega, so etnična skupina, doma v Srednji Ameriki. Ob prvih stikih s Španci v 16. stoletju so poseljevali pacifiške nižine Nikaragve in Hondurasa ter severozahodno Kostariko, v manjšem številu pa tudi skrajni vzhod Salvadorja. Jezik mangue, ki je izumrl v 20. stoletju, je spadal v oto-mangvansko jezikovno družino, ki se delno imenuje prav po njem kot njenem najjužnejšem članu.

Ocene o številu današnjih Mangue v Nikaragvi se močno razlikujejo: od okoli 10.000 leta 1981 in 46.000 po popisu leta 2005 do 166.000 po oceni Mednarodne organizacije dela iz leta 2006, 210.000 po navedbah aktivistov Chorotega in 221.000 po podatkih Mednarodne delovne skupine za domorodne zadeve. V Guaitilu v Kostariki so se Mangue zlili s kostariško kulturo in izgubili jezik, ohranili pa so lončarske tehnike in sloge. Matambú je edino domorodno ozemlje Chorotega v Kostariki.

source.title: Mangue people
paragraphs: The Mangue, also known as the Chorotega, are an ethnic group native to Central America. At the time of Spanish contact in the sixteenth century, they inhabited the Pacific lowlands of Nicaragua and Honduras, northwestern Costa Rica, and in smaller numbers easternmost El Salvador. The Mangue language has been extinct since the 20th century and belonged to the Oto-Manguean family, partially named for the Mangue as the southernmost member.

Estimates of the modern Mangue population in Nicaragua vary widely, from around 10,000 in 1981, to 46,000 according to the 2005 census, 166,000 according to an International Labour Organization estimate in 2006, 210,000 according to Chorotega activists, and 221,000 according to the International Work Group for Indigenous Affairs. In Guaitil, Costa Rica, the Mangue have been absorbed into the Costa Rican culture, losing their language, but pottery techniques and styles have been preserved. Matambú is the only Chorotega indigenous territory in Costa Rica.

Marksville culture.headline: Kultura Marksville
paragraphs: Kultura Marksville je bila arheološka kultura, ki je od leta 100 pr. n. št. do 400 n. št. obstajala v najnižjem delu doline spodnjega Misisipija ter v dolinah Yazoo in Tensas na območju današnje Louisiane, Misisipija in Arkansasa, proti vzhodu pa je segala ob zalivski obali do zaliva Mobile. Ime je dobila po prazgodovinskem indijanskem najdišču Marksville v okraju Avoyelles v Louisiani. Obstajala je hkrati s hopewellskimi kulturami v današnjem Ohiu in Illinoisu. Razvila se je iz starejše kulture Tchefuncte, iz nje pa sta izšli kulturi Baytown in Troyville, pozneje pa še kulturi Coles Creek in Plum Bayou. Velja za prednico zgodovinskih ljudstev Natchez in Taensa.

source.title: Marksville culture
paragraphs: The Marksville culture was an archaeological culture in the lower Lower Mississippi valley, Yazoo valley, and Tensas valley areas of present-day Louisiana, Mississippi, Arkansas, and extended eastward along the Gulf Coast to the Mobile Bay area, from 100 BCE to 400 CE. This culture takes its name from the Marksville Prehistoric Indian Site in Avoyelles Parish, Louisiana. Marksville Culture was contemporaneous with the Hopewell cultures within present-day Ohio and Illinois. It evolved from the earlier Tchefuncte culture and into the Baytown and Troyville cultures, and later the Coles Creek and Plum Bayou cultures. It is considered ancestral to the historic Natchez and Taensa peoples.

Mehičani (špansko: Mexicanos) so državljani Združenih mehiških držav. Mehiško ljudstvo je raznolikega izvora; najbolj razširjen jezik je španščina, mnogi pa govorijo tudi jezike 68 domorodnih jezikovnih skupin in druge jezike, ki so jih v Mehiko prinesli tujci ali novejši priseljenci. Leta 2020 se je za domorodce opredelilo 19,4 % mehiškega prebivalstva. Zunaj Mehike danes živi okoli 12 milijonov mehiških državljanov, od tega okoli 11,7 milijona v Združenih državah. Širša mehiška diaspora lahko zajema tudi ljudi, ki izvirajo iz Mehike in se imajo za Mehičane, nimajo pa nujno mehiškega državljanstva. Za Mehiko imajo največ mehiškega prebivalstva na svetu Združene države, leta 2024 kar 11.143.711.

source.title: Mexicans
paragraphs: Mexicans (Spanish: Mexicanos) are the citizens and nationals of the United Mexican States. The Mexican people have varied origins with the most spoken language being Spanish, but many also speak languages from 68 different Indigenous linguistic groups and other languages brought to Mexico by expatriates or recent immigration. In 2020, 19.4% of Mexico's population identified as Indigenous. There are currently about 12 million Mexican nationals residing outside Mexico, with about 11.7 million living in the United States. The larger Mexican diaspora can also include individuals that trace ancestry to Mexico and self-identify as Mexican but are not necessarily Mexican by citizenship. The United States has the largest Mexican population in the world after Mexico at 11,143,711 in 2024.

Mezcala culture.headline: Kultura Mezcala
paragraphs: Kultura Mezcala (včasih imenovana kultura Balsas) je ime mezoameriške kulture s središčem v južni mehiški zvezni državi Guerrero, v pokrajini ob gornjem toku reke Balsas. Slabo jo poznamo, domnevno pa se je razvila v srednjem in poznem predklasičnem obdobju mezoameriške kronologije, med letoma 700 in 200 pr. n. št. Obstajala je še v klasičnem obdobju (ok. 250–650 n. št.), ko je živela hkrati z velemestom Teotihuacan.
Arheologi so kulturo preučevali z omejenimi nadzorovanimi izkopavanji, s pregledom izropanih predmetov in s preučevanjem kipcev Mezcala, ki so jih našli kot daritve v azteškem kompleksu Tenochtitlan.

source.title: Mezcala culture
paragraphs: The Mezcala culture (sometimes referred to as the Balsas culture) is the name given to a Mesoamerican culture that was based in the southern Mexican state of Guerrero, in the upper Balsas River region. The culture is poorly understood but is believed to have developed during the Middle and Late Preclassic periods of Mesoamerican chronology, between 700 and 200 BC. The culture continued into the Classic period (c.250-650 AD) when it coexisted with the great metropolis of Teotihuacan.

Archaeologists have studied the culture through limited controlled excavations, the examination of looted artifacts, and the study of Mezcala sculptures found as dedicatory offerings at the Aztec complex of Tenochtitlan.

Michoacán.headline: Michoacán
paragraphs: Michoacán, formalno Michoacán de Ocampo, uradno Svobodna in suverena zvezna država Michoacán de Ocampo, je ena od 31 zveznih držav, ki skupaj z Ciudad de Méxicom sestavljajo zvezne enote Mehike. Razdeljena je na 113 občin, glavno mesto pa je Morelia (nekdaj Valladolid). Mesto je dobilo ime po Joséju Maríi Morelosu, ki se je tam rodil in je bil eden glavnih junakov mehiške osamosvojitvene vojne.

Michoacán leži v zahodni Mehiki in ima na jugozahodu kos obale ob Tihem oceanu. Na zahodu in severozahodu meji na zvezni državi Colima in Jalisco, na severu na Guanajuato, na severovzhodu na Querétaro, na vzhodu na zvezno državo México in na jugovzhodu na Guerrero.

source.title: Michoacán
paragraphs: Michoacán, formally Michoacán de Ocampo, officially the Free and Sovereign State of Michoacán de Ocampo, is one of the 31 states which, together with Mexico City, compose the Federal Entities of Mexico. The state is divided into 113 municipalities and its capital city is Morelia (formerly called Valladolid). The city was named after José María Morelos, a native of the city and one of the main heroes of the Mexican War of Independence.

Michoacán is located in western Mexico, and has a stretch of coastline on the Pacific Ocean to the southwest. It is bordered by the states of Colima and Jalisco to the west and northwest, Guanajuato to the north, Querétaro to the northeast, the State of México to the east, and Guerrero to the southeast.

Middle Archaic.headline: Srednje arhaično obdobje
paragraphs: Arhaično obdobje Severne Amerike je v razvrstitvi tamkajšnjih arheoloških kultur obdobje arhaične stopnje kulturnega razvoja, ki v zaporedju predkolumbovskih kulturnih stopenj traja približno od 8000 do 1000 pr. n. št. Zanj je značilno samooskrbno gospodarstvo, ki je temeljilo na nabiranju oreškov, semen in školjk. Ker konec obdobja določa prehod na stalno poljedelstvo, se njegov datum po Amerikah precej razlikuje.
Izraz »arhaično obdobje« označuje tudi časovna obdobja drugod po Amerikah, ki pa trajajo drugače kot severnoameriško.
notes: The English article read for this era is the introduction of the whole Archaic period ("Middle Archaic" redirects there), so the summary covers more than the middle phase.

source.title: Archaic period (North America)
paragraphs: In the classification of the archaeological cultures of North America, the Archaic period in North America, taken to last from around 8000 to 1000 BC in the sequence of North American pre-Columbian cultural stages, is a period defined by the archaic stage of cultural development. The Archaic stage is characterized by subsistence economies supported through the exploitation of nuts, seeds, and shellfish. As its ending is defined by the adoption of sedentary farming, this date can vary significantly across the Americas.
The term "Archaic Period" is also as a timespan label elsewhere in the Americas, with different timespans than the North American Archaic.

Mixtec culture.headline: Mikstekška kultura
paragraphs: Mikstekška kultura (imenovana tudi mikstekška civilizacija) je bila predkolumbovska arheološka kultura prednikov Mikstekov, ki so se imenovali Ñuu savi (ime, ki ga potomci ohranjajo še danes), kar pomeni »ljudje ali narod dežja«. Prve sledi segajo v srednje predklasično obdobje Mezoamerike (od 12. do 10. stoletja pr. n. št.), končala pa se je s španskim osvajanjem v prvih desetletjih 16. stoletja. Zgodovinsko ozemlje tega ljudstva je območje La Mixteca (v stari mikstekščini Ñuu Dzahui), gorata pokrajina med današnjimi mehiškimi zveznimi državami Puebla, Oaxaca in Guerrero.

source.title: Mixtec culture
paragraphs: The Mixtec culture (also called the Mixtec civilization) was a pre-Columbian archaeological culture, corresponding to the ancestors of the Mixtec people; they called themselves Ñuu savi (a name that their descendants still preserve), which means "people or nation of the rain". It had its first manifestations in the Mesoamerican Middle Preclassic period (12th century BC – 10th century BC) and ended with the Spanish conquest in the first decades of the 16th century. The historical territory of this people is the area known as La Mixteca (Ñuu Dzahui, in ancient Mixtec), a mountainous region located between the current Mexican states of Puebla, Oaxaca, and Guerrero.

Močejska kultura ali civilizacija Moche, imenovana tudi zgodnja kultura Chimú ali Pre- oziroma Proto-Chimú, je cvetela v severnem Peruju približno od leta 100 do 800 n. št., v obdobju regionalnega razvoja. Prestolnica južne močejske politične skupnosti je stala blizu današnjega kraja Moche pri Trujillu v Peruju, pod močejskim vplivom pa je bilo še več drugih, morda neodvisnih območij.

Mnogi raziskovalci menijo, da Močejci politično niso bili organizirani v enoten imperij ali državo. Verjetneje so bili skupina samostojnih političnih skupnosti s skupno kulturo, o kateri pričata bogata ikonografija in monumentalna arhitektura, ki sta se ohranili do danes.
notes: The pronunciation in IPA is left out.

source.title: Moche culture
paragraphs: The Moche civilization (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈmotʃe]; alternatively, the Moche culture or the Early, Pre- or Proto-Chimú) flourished in northern Peru from about 100 to 800 AD, during the Regional Development Epoch. The capital of a Southern Moche polity was near present-day Moche, Trujillo, Peru, with several other, possibly independent, regions under Moche influence.

Many scholars contend that the Moche were not politically organized as a monolithic empire or state. Rather, they were likely a group of autonomous polities that shared a common culture, as seen in the rich iconography and monumental architecture that survives today.

Mount Taylor period.headline: Obdobje Mount Taylor
paragraphs: Obdobje ali kultura Mount Taylor je bila predkeramična arheološka kultura na severovzhodu Floride v srednjem in poznem arhaičnem obdobju. Trajala je približno od leta 5000 ali 4000 pr. n. št. do 2000 pr. n. št. Večina z njo povezanih arheoloških najdišč leži v srednjem in gornjem delu doline reke St. Johns, sorodna najdišča pa so ob vzhodni obali Floride in še ponekod drugod na Floridi. Kultura Mount Taylor je izšla iz regionalno neizdiferencirane srednjearhaične kulture na Floridi, nasledilo pa jo je poznoarhaično obdobje Orange.

source.title: Mount Taylor period
paragraphs: The Mount Taylor period or Mount Taylor culture was a pre-ceramic archaeological culture in northeastern Florida in the middle to late Archaic period. The Mount Taylor period lasted from approximately 5000 or 4000 BCE to 2000 BCE. Most archaeological sites associated with the culture are in the middle and upper parts of the St. Johns River valley, with related sites occurring along the east coast of Florida, and at a few other places in Florida. The Mount Taylor culture emerged from the regionally undifferentiated middle Archaic culture in Florida, and was succeeded by the late Archaic Orange period.

Muiške zveze so bile ohlapne zveze različnih muiških poglavarstev v vzhodnem andskem visokogorju današnje Kolumbije pred špansko osvojitvijo severa Južne Amerike. Te povezave, zbrane okoli glavnih poglavarstev, ki so jih priznavala manjša, niso bile ena sama, četudi ohlapna, zveza muiških poglavarstev, temveč več samostojnih regionalnih tvorb. Območje, danes imenovano Altiplano Cundiboyacense, je obsegalo današnja departmaja Boyacá in Cundinamarca ter manjše dele departmaja Santander.

source.title: Muisca Confederations (political units)
paragraphs: Muisca Confederations were loose confederations of different Muisca chiefdoms in the Eastern Andean highlands of what is today Colombia before the Spanish conquest of northern South America. These unions, centred around main chiefdoms recognised by smaller ones, were not a single, even loose, muisca confederation of chiefdoms, but multiple, independent regional entities. The area, presently called Altiplano Cundiboyacense, comprised the current departments of Boyacá, Cundinamarca and minor parts of Santander.

New Granada.headline: Nova Granada
paragraphs: Nova Granada je bilo ime več nekdanjih državnih tvorb na ozemlju današnje Kolumbije:
Novo kraljestvo Granada od leta 1538 do 1717,
Podkraljestvo Nova Granada od leta 1717 do 1810 in znova od leta 1816 do 1822.

source.title: New Granada
paragraphs: New Granada may refer to various former national denominations for the present-day country of Colombia:
New Kingdom of Granada, from 1538 to 1717
Viceroyalty of New Granada, from 1717 to 1810, re-established from 1816 to 1822

Nikarao so domorodno nahuatlsko ljudstvo v zahodni Nikaragvi in severozahodni Kostariki. So najjužnejša nahuatlska skupina na jugu Mezoamerike. Govorili so jezik nahuat, ki je po španski osvojitvi Nikaragve in Kostarike postal ogrožen.

Nikarao so podskupina ljudstva Pipil; oboji izvirajo od Toltekov, ki so se iz Aridoamerike več stoletij selili proti jugu, začenši okoli leta 700 n. št., v poznem mezoameriškem klasičnem obdobju. Ta veja nahuatlskih ljudstev izvira iz Chiapasa, kjer so Tolteki, ki so govorili nahuat, živeli več sto let, preden so se preselili dlje v Srednjo Ameriko.

source.title: Nicarao people
paragraphs: The Nicarao are an Indigenous Nahua people living in western Nicaragua and northwestern Costa Rica. They are the southernmost Nahua group located in southern Mesoamerica. They spoke the Nahuat language before it became endangered after the Spanish conquest of Nicaragua and Costa Rica.

The Nicarao are a subgroup of the Pipil people, both of which are descended from the Toltecs, who migrated from Aridoamerica over the course of several centuries starting about 700 CE, the late Mesoamerican Classic period. This branch of the Nahua people originated in Chiapas, which was inhabited by Nawat-speaking Toltecs for hundreds of years before they migrated further into Central America.

Nordijska naselitev Severne Amerike, vključno z Grenlandijo, se je začela konec 10. stoletja n. št. in je trajala okoli 500 let. Zahodneje je dokazov manj. Potrjeno je le eno naselje v Kanadi, L'Anse aux Meadows na Novi Fundlandiji. Sledi nordijske dejavnosti so tudi drugod po Kanadi, a ni nobenih sledi trajnih kmečkih kolonij, kakršne so bile na Grenlandiji. Na ozemlju današnjih Združenih držav ni potrjenih ostankov; domnevna odkritja v ZDA so ponaredki ali zmote.

source.title: Norse settlement of North America
paragraphs: The Norse settlement of North America, including Greenland, began in the late 10th century AD and lasted for about 500 years. Further west, the evidence is more limited. Only one Canadian settlement has been confirmed: L'Anse aux Meadows in Newfoundland. There is evidence of Norse activity in other parts of Canada, but no trace of the long-term farming colonies found in Greenland. In the present-day United States, there are no confirmed remains. Claimed US discoveries are hoaxes or mistaken identifications.

Norton tradition.headline: Tradicija Norton
paragraphs: Tradicija Norton je arheološka kultura, ki se je okoli leta 1000 pr. n. št. razvila na zahodni Arktiki ob aljaški obali Beringove ožine in je trajala do okoli leta 800 n. št. Ljudje Norton so tako kot njihovi predhodniki iz arktične tradicije drobnega orodja uporabljali orodje iz odbitega kamna, a so bili bolj usmerjeni k morju in so začeli uporabljati nove tehnologije, kot so oljne svetilke in glinene posode.

Za preživetje so izkoriščali morske in kopenske vire: lovili so karibuje in manjše sesalce ter losose in večje morske sesalce. Naselja so bila razmeroma trajno poseljena, kar dokazujejo vaška najdišča z mogočnimi bivališči. Poleti so morda uporabljali majhne tabore kot začasna lovišča in ribolovna mesta, glavno bivališče pa so vzdrževali in se ob koncu lovne sezone vračali vanj. Okoli leta 700 pr. n. št. so prebivalci tradicije Norton na otoku sv. Lovrenca in drugih otokih Beringove ožine razvili še bolj specializirano, povsem na morje oprto kulturo, imenovano tradicija Thule.

source.title: Norton tradition
paragraphs: The Norton tradition is an archaeological culture that developed in the Western Arctic along the Alaskan shore of the Bering Strait around 1000 BC and lasted through about 800 AD. The Norton people used flake-stone tools like their predecessors, the Arctic small tool tradition, but they were more marine-oriented and brought new technologies such as oil-burning lamps and clay vessels into use.

Norton people used both marine and land resources as part of their subsistence strategy. They hunted caribou and smaller mammals as well as salmon and larger sea mammals. Their settlements were occupied fairly permanently, as is evidenced by village sites which contain substantial dwellings. During summer months, small camps may have been used as temporary hunting and fishing locations, but the main dwelling place was maintained and returned to at the end of the hunting season. In about 700 BC, the Norton inhabitants of the St. Lawrence and other Bering Strait Islands developed an even more specialized culture, based entirely on the ocean, called the Thule tradition.

Omagua people.headline: Ljudstvo Omagua
paragraphs: Omagua (znani tudi kot Umawa, Cambeba in Kambeba) so domorodno ljudstvo v brazilskem porečju Amazonke. Ob prvih stikih s španskimi raziskovalci v 16. stoletju je njihovo ozemlje segalo ob Amazonki od današnjega mesta Manaus navzgor do Peruja. Govorijo jezik omagua. Danes jih je malo, v poznem predkolumbovskem obdobju pa so bili številna in organizirana družba. V prvih letih kolumbovske izmenjave je njihovo število strmo upadlo, predvsem zaradi nalezljivih bolezni. V 18. stoletju so se zaradi predsodkov in rasizma, ki sta domorodna ljudstva v Braziliji in Peruju potiskala na rob, večinoma odrekli domorodni identiteti. Ko so se v 1980. letih odnosi omilili, se je njihova plemenska identiteta znova okrepila.

source.title: Omagua people
paragraphs: The Omagua people (also known as the Umawa, Cambeba, and Kambeba) are an Indigenous people in Brazil's Amazon Basin. Their territory, when first in contact with Spanish explorers in the 16th century, was on the Amazon River upstream from the present-day city of Manaus extending into Peru. They speak the Omagua language. The Omagua exist today in small numbers, but they were a populous, organized society in the late Pre-Columbian era. Their population suffered steep decline, mostly from infectious diseases, in the early years of the Columbian Exchange. During the 18th century, the Omagua largely abandoned their Indigenous identity in response to prejudice and racism that marginalized aboriginal peoples in Brazil and Peru. More tolerant attitudes led to a renewed tribal identity starting in the 1980s.

Oneota.headline: Oneota
paragraphs: Oneota je oznaka, s katero arheologi označujejo kulturni kompleks, ki je obstajal na vzhodnih planjavah in na območju Velikih jezer na ozemlju današnjih Združenih držav približno od leta 900 n. št. do okoli leta 1650 ali 1700. Po razvrstitvi, ki sta jo Gordon Willey in Philip Phillips opredelila v knjigi Method and Theory in American Archaeology (Metoda in teorija v ameriški arheologiji) iz leta 1958, kultura Oneota spada v formativno stopnjo. Domnevno se je preoblikovala v različne siujevske kulture protozgodovinskega in zgodovinskega obdobja, kot so Ioway.

Oneota velja za pomembno sestavino gornjemisisipijske kulture. Zanjo je značilna kroglasta lončenina s pustilom iz školjčnih lupin, pogosto grobe sestave. Posode so imele pogosto okroglo telo, kratek vrat in/ali raven rob, včasih tudi trakaste ročaje. Okrasje so valovite in cikcakaste črte, pogosto vzporedne, večinoma na zgornji polovici posode. Eno od najdišč, ki so ga ljudje Oneota nekaj časa poseljevali, je najdišče Aztalan ob reki Crawfish v Wisconsinu.

source.title: Oneota
paragraphs: Oneota is a designation archaeologists use to refer to a cultural complex that existed in the Eastern Plains and Great Lakes area of what is now occupied by the United States from around AD 900 to around 1650 or 1700. Based on the classification defined in Gordon Willey and Philip Phillips' 1958 book Method and Theory in American Archaeology, the Oneota culture belongs to formative stage. The culture is believed to have transitioned into various Siouan cultures of the protohistoric and historic times, such as the Ioway.

Oneota is considered a major component of Upper Mississippian culture. It is characterized by globular, shell-tempered pottery that is often coarse in fibre. Pieces often had a spherical body, short necks and/or a flat lip. Sometimes the vessels had strap handles. Decoration includes wavy and zigzag lines, often in parallel. Most decoration was done on the top half of the vessel. One site occupied by the Oneota people for a period was the Aztalan site beside the Crawfish River in Wisconsin.

Orange period.headline: Obdobje Orange
paragraphs: Obdobje ali kultura Orange je bila poznoarhaična arheološka kultura ob vzhodni strani polotoka Florida, ki je trajala od pred približno 4000 leti do pred približno 2500 ali 3000 leti. Opredeljuje jo predvsem lončenina serije Orange s pustilom iz rastlinskih vlaken.

source.title: Orange period
paragraphs: The Orange period or Orange culture was a late-Archaic archaeological culture along the eastern side of the Florida peninsula, from about 4,000 years ago to about 2,500 or 3,000 years ago. The Orange period is largely defined by the presence of Orange-series fiber-tempered pottery.

Ortoiroid people.headline: Ortoiroidi
paragraphs: Ortoiroidi so bili drugi val naseljencev na Karibih, ki so se okoli leta 2000 pr. n. št. začeli seliti na Antile. Pred njimi so tam živela kazimiroidna ljudstva (ok. 4190–2165 pr. n. št.). Domnevno so izvirali iz doline Orinoka v Južni Ameriki in se na Antile selili prek Trinidada in Tobaga vse do Portorika. Ime »ortoiroidni« izvira iz Ortoira, najdišča školjčnega kupa na jugovzhodu Trinidada. Po drugem arheološkem najdišču na Trinidadu jih imenujejo tudi banwaroidna ljudstva.

source.title: Ortoiroid people
paragraphs: The Ortoiroid people were the second wave of settlers of the Caribbean who began their migration into the Antilles around 2000 BC. They were preceded by the Casimiroid peoples (~4190-2165 BC). They are believed to have originated in the Orinoco valley in South America, migrating to the Antilles from Trinidad and Tobago to Puerto Rico. The name "Ortoiroid" comes from Ortoire, a shell midden site in southeast Trinidad. They have also been called Banwaroid, after another archaeological site in Trinidad.

Perujsko-bolivijska konfederacija (špansko: Confederación Perú–Boliviana) je bila kratkotrajna država, ki je v Južni Ameriki obstajala med letoma 1836 in 1839. Bila je ohlapna konfederacija treh držav: Severnega Peruja, Južnega Peruja in Bolivijske republike. Severni in Južni Peru sta nastala z razdelitvijo Perujske republike po perujski državljanski vojni leta 1834 in vojni med Salaverryjem in Santa Cruzom v letih 1835–1836.

Meje konfederacije so se s časom spreminjale: leta 1838 je Bolivija zasedla in priključila nekatera sporna ozemlja na severu Argentine. Konfederaciji so pripadala tudi dejansko samostojna domorodna ozemlja, kot je bil Iquicha. Vse je bilo pod vrhovnim poveljstvom maršala Andrésa de Santa Cruza, ki je leta 1836 kot predsednik Bolivije prevzel položaj vrhovnega zaščitnika.

source.title: Peru–Bolivian Confederation
paragraphs: The Peru–Bolivian Confederation (Spanish: Confederación Perú–Boliviana) was a short-lived state that existed in South America between 1836 and 1839. The country was a loose confederation made up of three states: North Peru, South Peru, and the Bolivian Republic. North Peru and South Peru had emerged from the division of the Peruvian Republic due to the Peruvian Civil War of 1834 and the Salaverry-Santa Cruz War of 1835–36.

The geographical limits of the Confederation varied over time, with Bolivia occupying and incorporating certain disputed territories in northern Argentina in 1838. It also possessed de facto autonomous indigenous territories, such as Iquicha, all under the supreme command of Marshal Andrés de Santa Cruz, who assumed the position of Supreme Protector in 1836, while he was president of Bolivia.

Plaquemine culture.headline: Kultura Plaquemine
paragraphs: Kultura Plaquemine je bila arheološka kultura (ok. 1200–1700 n. št.) s središčem v dolini spodnjega Misisipija. Na tem območju je imela dolgo zgodovino, ki sega prek starejših kultur Coles Creek (700–1200 n. št.) in Troyville (400–700 n. št.) do kulture Marksville (100 pr. n. št.–400 n. št.). Njeni potomci v zgodovinskem obdobju so bila ljudstva Natchez in sorodno ljudstvo Taensa. Tipsko najdišče kulture je najdišče Medora v Louisiani, med drugimi primeri pa so najdišča Anna, Emerald, Holly Bluff in Winterville v Misisipiju.

source.title: Plaquemine culture
paragraphs: The Plaquemine culture was an archaeological culture (circa 1200 to 1700 CE) centered on the Lower Mississippi River valley. It had a deep history in the area stretching back through the earlier Coles Creek (700–1200 CE) and Troyville cultures (400–700 CE) to the Marksville culture (100 BCE to 400 CE). The Natchez and related Taensa peoples were their historic period descendants. The type site for the culture is the Medora site in Louisiana; while other examples include the Anna, Emerald, Holly Bluff, and Winterville sites in Mississippi.

Plum Bayou culture.headline: Kultura Plum Bayou
paragraphs: Kultura Plum Bayou je predkolumbovska indijanska kultura, ki je od leta 650 do 1050 n. št., v poznem gozdnem obdobju, živela na vzhodu osrednjega Arkansasa. Arheologi so jo opredelili po najdišču gomil Plum Bayou, prej znanem kot Toltec Mounds, in jo poimenovali po bližnjem vodotoku.

source.title: Plum Bayou culture
paragraphs: Plum Bayou culture is a Pre-Columbian Native American culture that lived in what is now east-central Arkansas from 650–1050 CE, a time known as the Late Woodland Period. Archaeologists defined the culture based on the Plum Bayou Mounds site, previously known as Toltec Mounds, and named it for a local waterway.

Point Peninsula complex.headline: Kompleks Point Peninsula
paragraphs: Kompleks Point Peninsula je bila domorodna kultura v Ontariu in New Yorku, ki je obstajala od leta 600 pr. n. št. do 700 n. št., v srednjem gozdnem obdobju. Lončenina Point Peninsula se je v Kanadi pojavila okoli leta 600 pr. n. št., nato pa se je okoli leta 200 pr. n. št. razširila na jug, v dele Nove Anglije. Nekje med letoma 300 pr. n. št. in 1 n. št. se je pojavila v Mainu in »po vsem pomorskem polotoku«. Malo je dokazov, da bi se razvila iz starejše, debelejše lončenine, znane kot Vinette I, Adena Thick in podobno. Bila je nova tehnologija v Severni Ameriki in jo imenujejo tudi Vinette II. V primerjavi z dotedanjo debelejšo in manj okrašeno keramiko jo odlikuje »boljše oblikovanje gline, posode so tanjše, bolje žgane in s finejšim pustilom«. Od kod je ta tehnologija prišla, ni zanesljivo znano; njen izvor je »nekoliko problematičen«. Ljudstvo so domnevno oblikovale hopewellske tradicije iz doline reke Ohio. Ta vpliv je očitno usahnil okoli leta 250 n. št., nato pa pogrebnih obredov niso več izvajali.

source.title: Point Peninsula complex
paragraphs: The Point Peninsula complex was an indigenous culture located in Ontario and New York from 600 BCE to 700 CE (during the Middle Woodland period). Point Peninsula ceramics were first introduced into Canada around 600 BCE then spread south into parts of New England around 200 BCE. Some time between 300 BCE and 1 CE, Point Peninsula pottery first appeared in Maine, and "over the entire Maritime Peninsula." Little evidence exists to show that it was derived from the earlier, thicker pottery, known as Vinette I, Adena Thick, etc... Point Peninsula pottery represented a new kind of technology in North America and has also been called Vinette II. Compared to existing ceramics that were thicker and less decorated, this new pottery has been characterized by "superior modeling of the clay with vessels being thinner, better fired and containing finer grit temper." Where this new pottery technology originated is not known for sure. The origin of this pottery is "somewhat of a problem." The people are thought to have been influenced by the Hopewell traditions of the Ohio River valley. This influence seems to have ended about 250 CE, after which they no longer practiced burial ceremonialism.

Poverty Point culture.headline: Kultura Poverty Point
paragraphs: Kultura Poverty Point je arheološka kultura prazgodovinskih domorodnih ljudstev, ki so približno od leta 1730 do 1350 pr. n. št. poseljevala del doline spodnjega Misisipija v Severni Ameriki in bližnje zalivske obale. Ime je dobila po svojem najbolj znanem arheološkem najdišču.
Arheologi so odkrili več kot 100 najdišč te kulture graditeljev gomil, ki je spletla tudi veliko trgovsko mrežo po velikem delu vzhodnega dela današnjih Združenih držav.

source.title: Poverty Point culture
paragraphs: The Poverty Point culture is the archaeological culture of prehistoric indigenous peoples who inhabited a portion of North America's lower Mississippi Valley and surrounding Gulf coast from about 1730 – 1350 BC. They are named after their best-known archeological site.

Archeologists have identified more than 100 sites belonging to this mound-builder culture, who also formed a large trading network throughout much of the eastern part of what is now the United States.

Pukara culture.headline: Kultura Pukara
paragraphs: Kultura Pukara ali Pucará je bila arheološka kultura, ki se je razvila v pokrajini Qullaw ob severozahodni obali jezera Titicaca. Zanjo je bila značilna hierarhija manjših središč in vasi, raztresenih po severnem delu porečja jezera. Ime je dobila po kraju Pukara, enem največjih naselij v pokrajini; današnje mestece Pucará leži pol milje vzhodno od arheološkega najdišča. Kultura nima nobene zveze s kamnitimi utrdbami pukarami, ki so jih v času Inkovskega imperija gradili po vseh Andih. Njen vpliv je segal na sever do doline Cuzca in na jug do Tiwanakuja. V formativnem obdobju je imela dve razvojni fazi: srednjo formativno (1400–550 pr. n. št.) in pozno formativno (550 pr. n. št.–400 n. št.).

source.title: Pukara culture
paragraphs: The Pukara or Pucará culture was an archaeological culture which developed in Qullaw, along the north-western shore of Lake Titicaca. It was characterized by a hierarchy of smaller centers and villages scattered throughout the northern basin of the Titicaca. The name originates from the town of Pukara, one of the largest settlements in the region. The modern town of Pucará is located half a mile to the east of the archaeological site. The Pukara culture is unrelated to the stone fortresses, pukaras, built across the Andes during the Inca Empire. Its sphere of influence reached as far north as the Cuzco Valley and as far south as Tiahuanaco. The culture had two phases of development within the Formative Period: the Middle Formative (1400 to 550 BC), and Late Formative (550 BC to 400 AD).

Quimbaya.headline: Quimbaya
paragraphs: Quimbaya so bili majhna starodavna domorodna skupina na območju današnje Kolumbije, znana po zlatarskih izdelkih s tehnično natančnostjo in podrobnimi vzorci. Večina izdelkov je iz zlitine tumbaga s 30 % bakra, ki jim daje barvo.
notes: The pronunciation in IPA is left out.

source.title: Quimbaya
paragraphs: The Quimbaya (/kɪmbaɪa/) were a small, ancient indigenous group in present-day Colombia noted for their gold work characterized by technical accuracy and detailed designs. The majority of the gold work is made in tumbaga alloy, with 30% copper, which colours the pieces.

Quitu culture.headline: Kultura Quitu
paragraphs: Quitu ali Quillaco so bila predkolumbovska domorodna ljudstva v Ekvadorju, ki so ustanovila Quito, današnjo prestolnico Ekvadorja. Ozemlju so vladala od leta 2000 pr. n. št. in so se obdržala vse obdobje regionalne integracije, dokler jih ni premagala inkovska invazija. Leta 1534 so središče napadli in osvojili Španci.

Quitu so živeli na goratem območju in so se naseljevali predvsem v dolinah. Okoli leta 800 n. št. so na planoti v okviru pogrebnih središč zgradili 20 metrov globoke grobnice na treh ravneh. Mrtvim so dali izjemno prefinjene pridatke iz tkanin, školjk in kovin ter pijačo in hrano za posmrtno življenje. Grobnice so odkrili v Quitovi četrti Florida, kjer so leta 2010 odprli Muzej Florida, ki razstavlja velik del njihovih zakladov.

source.title: Quitu culture
paragraphs: The Quitu or Quillaco were pre-Columbian indigenous peoples in Ecuador who founded Quito, which is the capital of present-day Ecuador. This people ruled the territory from 2000 BCE and persisted through the period known as the Regional Integration Period. They were overtaken by the invasion of the Inca. The Spanish invaded and conquered the center in 1534.

The Quitu occupied an area dominated by mountains, settling largely in the valleys. About 800 CE, they created three-level, 20-meter deep tombs as part of funerary centers on the plateau. The bodies were accompanied by highly refined grave goods of textiles, shells and metals, as well as drink and food for the afterlife. These tombs were discovered in the Florida neighborhood of Quito, and in 2010 the Museum of Florida opened to display many of their treasures.

Republic of Baja California.headline: Republika Spodnja Kalifornija
paragraphs: Republika Spodnja Kalifornija (špansko: República de Baja California) je bila predlagana država v letih 1853 in 1854, potem ko je ameriškemu vodji zasebne vojske Williamu Walkerju spodletel vdor iz Arizone v Sonoro. Walker si je hotel prilastiti Sonoro, njegove zahteve pa so v Združenih državah uživale podporo tajkunov in popustljivost vlade.

source.title: Republic of Baja California
paragraphs: The Republic of Baja California, also known in Spanish as the República de Baja California, was a proposed state from 1853 to 1854, after American private military leader William Walker failed to invade Sonora from Arizona. Walker wanted to appropriate Sonora, and his claims had both the support of tycoons and government complacency in the United States.

Republika Nova Granada je bila centralistična unitarna republika, ki je od leta 1831 do 1858 obsegala predvsem današnjo Kolumbijo in Panamo ter manjše dele današnje Kostarike, Ekvadorja, Venezuele, Peruja in Brazilije. Nastala je po razpadu Velike Kolumbije leta 1830, ko sta se odcepila Ekvador in Venezuela. Leta 1858 so jo preimenovali v Granadsko konfederacijo.
Državno zastavo z barvami Velike Kolumbije v Velesovi razporeditvi so sprejeli 9. maja 1834 in jo uporabljali do 26. novembra 1861. Trgovska zastava je imela belo osemkrako zvezdo.

source.title: Republic of New Granada
paragraphs: The Republic of New Granada was a centralist unitary republic consisting primarily of present-day Colombia and Panama with smaller portions of today's Costa Rica, Ecuador, Venezuela, Peru and Brazil that existed from 1831 to 1858. The state was created after the dissolution of Gran Colombia in 1830 through the secession of Ecuador and Venezuela. In 1858, the state was renamed into the Granadine Confederation.
The national flag, with the Gran Colombian colours in Veles' arrangement, was adopted on 9 May 1834 and used until 26 November 1861. The merchant ensign had the eight-pointed star in white.

Republika Rio Grande (špansko: República del Río Grande) je ime, ki so ga angloameriški časopisi in poznejši zgodovinski spisi dali federalističnemu uporu ob spodnjem toku reke Rio Grande v letih 1838–1840. Hunta, ki se je 23. januarja 1840 sestala v Casa Blanci pod vodstvom Antonia Canalesa Rosilla, Jesúsa de Cárdenasa in drugih, ni priznala centralistične vlade v Ciudad de Méxicu in je postavila začasno vlado, dokler se ne bi sestala skupščina vseh mehiških zveznih držav. Upor se je končal s konvencijo v Camargu 6. novembra 1840, ki jo je ratificiral Canales in odobril general Mariano Arista.

Teksaški viri so gibanje obravnavali kot odcepitev po zgledu Republike Teksas. Dokumenti voditeljev upora pa tega imena ne uporabljajo in o odcepitvi ne govorijo; v njih stojijo izrazi frontera del norte, villas del norte in gobierno provisional.

source.title: Republic of the Rio Grande
paragraphs: The Republic of the Rio Grande (Spanish: República del Río Grande) is the name given in Anglo‐American newspapers, and in later histories, to a federalist revolt on the lower Rio Grande in 1838–1840. A junta at Casa Blanca on 23 January 1840, headed by Antonio Canales Rosillo, Jesús de Cárdenas, and others withheld recognition from the centralist government in Mexico City and set up a provisional government until a convention of all the states of Mexico could meet. The revolt ended with the convention of Camargo on 6 November 1840, ratified by Canales and approved by General Mariano Arista.

Texas accounts have treated the movement as a secession on the model of the Republic of Texas. The leaders' own papers do not use the name and do not speak of separation; they use frontera del norte, villas del norte and gobierno provisional.

Republika Riograndense, pogosto imenovana Republika Piratini (portugalsko: República Rio-Grandense ali República do Piratini), je bila dejanska država, ki se je odcepila od Brazilskega cesarstva in se je v grobem ujemala z današnjo zvezno državo Rio Grande do Sul. Razglasil jo je 11. septembra 1836 general Antônio de Sousa Neto, kar je bila neposredna posledica zmage oligarhičnih gavčovskih sil v bitki pri Seivalu (1836) med vojno raztrgancev (1835–1845). Leta 1843 je sprejela ustavo, priznali pa so jo le Združeno kraljestvo, Francija in Urugvaj.
notes: Ragamuffin War rendered as vojna raztrgancev (Guerra dos Farrapos); worth a reviewer's check.

source.title: Riograndense Republic
paragraphs: The Riograndense Republic, often called the Piratini Republic (Portuguese: República Rio-Grandense or República do Piratini), was a de facto state that seceded from the Empire of Brazil and roughly coincided with the present state of Rio Grande do Sul. It was proclaimed on 11 September 1836 by general Antônio de Sousa Neto as a direct consequence of the victory obtained by gaúcho oligarchic forces at the Battle of Seival (1836) during the Ragamuffin War (1835–1845). It had a constitution adopted in 1843 and was recognised only by the United Kingdom, France, and Uruguay.

Saladoid.headline: Saladoidna kultura
paragraphs: Saladoidna kultura je predkolumbovska domorodna kultura na ozemlju današnje Venezuele in Karibov, ki je cvetela od leta 500 pr. n. št. do 545 n. št. Njeni nosilci so živeli predvsem v nižinah ob reki Orinoko, nato pa so se po morju preselili na Male Antile in naprej v Portoriko.

source.title: Saladoid
paragraphs: The Saladoid culture is a pre-Columbian Indigenous culture of territory in present-day Venezuela and the Caribbean that flourished from 500 BCE to 545 CE. Concentrated along the lowlands of the Orinoco River, the people migrated by sea to the Lesser Antilles, and then to Puerto Rico.

Drugo mehiško cesarstvo (špansko: Segundo Imperio mexicano), uradno Mehiško cesarstvo (Imperio Mexicano), je bila ustavna monarhija, ki so jo v Mehiki ob podpori drugega francoskega cesarstva ustanovili mehiški monarhisti. To obdobje pogosto imenujejo druga francoska intervencija v Mehiki. Francoski cesar Napoleon III. je s podporo mehiških konservativcev, duhovščine in plemstva hotel v Amerikah ustvariti monarhističnega zaveznika, ki bi uravnotežil vse večjo moč Združenih držav.

Mehiški monarhisti, ki so izgubili državljansko vojno proti mehiškim liberalcem, so prestol ponudili avstrijskemu nadvojvodi Maksimilijanu iz habsburško-lotarinške rodbine, ki je bil v sorodu z vladarji kolonialne Mehike. Njegov vzpon na prestol so potrdili s spornim referendumom. Njegova žena, belgijska princesa Šarlota iz saško-coburško-gotske rodbine, je postala mehiška cesarica, v Mehiki znana kot »Carlota«.

source.title: Second Mexican Empire
paragraphs: The Second Mexican Empire (Spanish: Segundo Imperio mexicano), officially known as the Mexican Empire (Spanish: Imperio Mexicano), was a constitutional monarchy established in Mexico by Mexican monarchists with the support of the Second French Empire. This period is often referred to as the Second French intervention in Mexico. The French Emperor, Napoleon III, with backing from Mexican conservatives, the clergy, and nobility, aimed to establish a monarchist ally in the Americas as a counterbalance to the growing power of the United States.

The throne of Mexico was offered by Mexican monarchists, who had lost a civil war against Mexican liberals, to Austrian Archduke Maximilian of the House of Habsburg-Lorraine, who had ancestral ties to the rulers of colonial Mexico. Maximilian's ascension was ratified through a controversial referendum. His wife, Belgian princess Charlotte of the House of Saxe-Coburg and Gotha, became the empress consort of Mexico, known locally as "Carlota".

Sican culture.headline: Kultura Sicán
paragraphs: Kultura Sican (tudi Sicán) je ime, ki ga je arheolog Izumi Šimada dal kulturi, ki je približno med letoma 750 in 1375 n. št. poseljevala današnjo severno obalo Peruja. Po Šimadi Sican pomeni »Lunin tempelj«. Po perujski pokrajini jo imenujejo tudi kultura Lambayeque. Nasledila je močejsko kulturo, med arheologi in antropologi pa se še vedno krešejo mnenja, ali sta to res ločeni kulturi. Kulturo Sican po spremembah, ki jih kažejo arheološke najdbe, delijo na tri glavna obdobja.
notes: Izumi Shimada transcribed as Izumi Šimada.

source.title: Sican culture
paragraphs: The Sican (also Sicán) culture is the name that archaeologist Izumi Shimada gave to the culture that inhabited what is now the north coast of Peru between about 750 and 1375 CE. According to Shimada, Sican means "temple of the Moon". The Sican culture is also referred to as Lambayeque culture, after the name of the region in Peru. It succeeded the Moche culture. There is still controversy among archeologists and anthropologists over whether the two are separate cultures. The Sican culture is divided into three major periods based on cultural changes as evidenced in archeological artifacts.

State of Buenos Aires.headline: Država Buenos Aires
paragraphs: Država Buenos Aires (špansko: Estado de Buenos Aires) je bila odcepljena republika, ki je nastala, ko so v provinci Buenos Aires 11. septembra 1852 strmoglavili vlado Argentinske konfederacije. Konfederacija je ni nikoli izrecno priznala, a je ostala neodvisna z lastno vlado in ustavo. Buenos Aires se je Argentinski konfederaciji znova pridružil po svoji zmagi v bitki pri Pavónu leta 1861.

source.title: State of Buenos Aires
paragraphs: The State of Buenos Aires (Spanish: Estado de Buenos Aires) was a secessionist republic resulting from the overthrow of the Argentine Confederation government in the Province of Buenos Aires on 11 September 1852. The State of Buenos Aires was never explicitly recognized by the Confederation; it remained, however, independent under its own government and constitution. Buenos Aires rejoined the Argentine Confederation after the former's victory at the Battle of Pavón in 1861.
Tehuelči, imenovani tudi Aónikenk, so domorodno ljudstvo iz vzhodne Patagonije v Južni Ameriki. V 18. in 19. stoletju so bili pod vplivom Mapučev in so mnogi začeli rediti konje.

Nekoč nomadsko ljudstvo je zašlo v stisko, ko sta njegovo zemljo v 19. stoletju kolonizirali Argentina in Čile, kar je postopoma razkrojilo njegovo tradicionalno gospodarstvo. Še posebej so jih prizadela velika ovčarska posestva, ki so jih kolonisti ustanovili v Patagoniji. Stiki z evropskimi priseljenci so prinesli tudi nove nalezljive bolezni, ki so med plemeni Tehuelčev povzročile smrtonosne epidemije, saj niso imeli pridobljene odpornosti. Danes večina Tehuelčev živi v mestih in krajih argentinske Patagonije.

source.title: Tehuelche people
paragraphs: The Tehuelche people, also called the Aónikenk, are an Indigenous people from eastern Patagonia in South America. In the 18th and 19th centuries, the Tehuelche were influenced by the Mapuche people, and many adopted the domestic use of horses.

Once a nomadic people, the Tehuelche struggled as their lands were colonized in the 19th century by Argentina and Chile, which gradually disrupted their traditional economies. The colonial establishment of large sheep farming estates in Patagonia was particularly detrimental to the Tehuelche. Contact with ethnic European outsiders also introduced new infectious diseases, which caused deadly epidemics among Tehuelche tribes as they lacked acquired immunity. Today most Tehuelche reside in cities and towns of Argentine Patagonia.

Thule people.headline: Ljudstvo Thule
paragraphs: Ljudstvo Thule ali protoinuiti so bili predniki vseh današnjih Inuitov in Jupikov. Do leta 1000 n. št. so se razvili na obali Aljaske in se razširili proti vzhodu prek severne Kanade, do 13. stoletja pa so dosegli Grenlandijo. Pri tem so izpodrinili ljudi starejše kulture Dorset, ki so prej živeli na tem območju. Ime »Thule« izvira iz kraja Thule, danes Pituffik (naselje so leta 1953 preselili in preimenovali v Qaanaaq), na severozahodu Grenlandije nasproti Kanade, kjer so arheološke ostanke tega ljudstva prvič našli na kupu odpadkov Comer's Midden.

Dokazi podpirajo domnevo, da so bili ljudje Thule (in v manjši meri Dorset) v stiku z Vikingi, ki so v 11. stoletju v okviru nordijske kolonizacije Severne Amerike dosegli obale Kanade. Vikinški viri ta ljudstva imenujejo Skrælingjar.
notes: The pronunciation respelling is left out.

source.title: Thule people
paragraphs: The Thule ( TOO-lee, also THOOL) or proto-Inuit were the precursors of all modern Inuit and Yupik peoples. They developed in coastal Alaska by 1000 CE and expanded eastward across northern Canada, reaching Greenland by the 13th century. In the process, they replaced people of the earlier Dorset culture who had previously inhabited the region. The appellation "Thule" originates from the location of Thule, now known as Pituffik (a settlement relocated and renamed Qaanaaq in 1953) in northwest Greenland, facing Canada, where the archaeological remains of the people were first found at Comer's Midden.

Evidence supports the idea that the Thule (and, to a lesser degree, the Dorset) were in contact with the Vikings, who had reached the shores of Canada in the 11th century as part of the Norse colonization of North America. In Viking sources, these peoples are called the Skrælingjar.

Tiwanaku (špansko: Tiahuanaco ali Tiahuanacu) je bila predkolumbovska politična skupnost v zahodni Boliviji s središčem v južnem delu porečja jezera Titicaca. Bila je ena najpomembnejših andskih civilizacij: njen vpliv je segal na ozemlje današnjega Peruja in Čila in je trajal približno od leta 600 do 1000. Prestolnica je bilo monumentalno mesto Tiwanaku sredi osrednjega območja države v južnem delu porečja jezera. Tam so jasni dokazi za obsežno poljedelstvo na dvignjenih poljih, ki so verjetno preživljala mestno prebivalstvo prestolnice. Raziskovalci razpravljajo, ali je ta polja upravljala birokratska država (od zgoraj navzdol) ali zveza skupnosti s krajevno samoupravo (od spodaj navzgor; pregled razprave v Janusek 2004: 57–73). Nekoč so Tiwanaku imeli za širok vojaški imperij, predvsem zaradi primerjav s poznejšim Inkovskim imperijem. Novejše raziskave pa kažejo, da je oznaka imperij ali celo država morda zavajajoča. Tiwanakuju namreč manjkajo številne značilnosti, s katerimi tradicionalno opredeljujejo starodavne države in imperije: na nobenem najdišču ni obrambne arhitekture ali sprememb v orožju, ni kneževskih grobov ali drugih sledi vladajoče dinastije, ni sledi cest ali postojank, ki bi jih vzdrževala država, in ni tržnic.

source.title: Tiwanaku polity
paragraphs: The Tiwanaku polity (Spanish: Tiahuanaco or Tiahuanacu) was a Pre-Columbian polity in western Bolivia based in the southern Lake Titicaca Basin. Tiwanaku was one of the most significant Andean civilizations. Its influence extended into present-day Peru and Chile and lasted from around 600 to 1000. Its capital was the monumental city of Tiwanaku, located at the center of the polity's core area in the southern Lake Titicaca Basin. This area has clear evidence for large-scale agricultural production on raised fields that probably supported the urban population of the capital. Researchers debate whether these fields were administered by a bureaucratic state (top-down) or through a federation of communities with local autonomy (bottom-up; see review of debate in Janusek 2004:57-73). Tiwanaku was once thought to be an expansive military empire, based mostly on comparisons to the later Inca Empire. However, recent research suggests that labelling Tiwanaku as an empire or even a state may be misleading. Tiwanaku is missing a number of features traditionally used to define archaic states and empires: there is no defensive architecture at any Tiwanaku site or changes in weapon technology, there are no princely burials or other evidence of a ruling dynasty, no evidence of state-maintained roads or outposts, and no markets.

Združene države Kolumbije (špansko: Estados Unidos de Colombia) je ime, ki ga je Granadski konfederaciji po letih državljanske vojne leta 1863 dala ustava iz Rionegra (Constitución de Rionegro). Kolumbija je postala zvezna država iz devetih »suverenih držav«. Obsegala je današnji državi Kolumbijo in Panamo ter dele severozahodne Brazilije. Po nadaljnjih letih občasnih državljanskih vojn jo je leta 1886 nadomestila bolj centralistična Republika Kolumbija, predhodnica današnje Kolumbije.

source.title: United States of Colombia
paragraphs: The United States of Colombia (Spanish: Estados Unidos de Colombia) was the name adopted in 1863 by the Constitución de Rionegro for the Granadine Confederation, after years of civil war. Colombia became a federal state itself composed of nine "sovereign states." It comprised the present-day nations of Colombia and Panama and parts of northwestern Brazil. After several more years of intermittent civil wars, it was replaced by the more centralist Republic of Colombia in 1886, predecessor to modern Colombia.

Wari Empire.headline: Imperij Wari
paragraphs: Imperij Wari ali Huari je bila politična tvorba, ki je nastala okoli leta 600 n. št. v perujskem porečju Ayacucho in se razširila na velik del obalnega in visokogorskega Peruja. Imperij je trajal okoli 500 let, do leta 1100 n. št. Obstajal je ob istem času kot kultura Tiwanaku in nekoč so menili, da je iz nje izšel.

Leta 2008 so arheologi blizu današnjega Chiclaya našli predkolumbovsko mesto, severne razvaline Wari (imenovane tudi Cerro Pátapo), prvo obsežno naselje kulture Wari tako daleč na severu. Arheološka odkritja so se nadaljevala tudi v zadnjem desetletju: leta 2023 so arheologi v Arequipi odkrili 1200 let star obredni kompleks Wari. Z vsakim novim odkritjem lahko arheologi o kulturi imperija Wari sklepajo več.

source.title: Wari Empire
paragraphs: The Wari Empire or Huari Empire was a political formation that emerged in around 600 CE in Peru's Ayacucho Basin and grew to cover much of coastal and highland Peru. The empire lasted for about 500 years, until 1100 CE. It existed during the same era as the Tiwanaku culture, and at one time, was thought to have been derived from it.

In 2008, archeologists found a pre-Columbian city, the Northern Wari ruins (also called Cerro Pátapo) near modern Chiclayo. The find was the first extensive settlement related to the Wari culture discovered that far north. Archaeological discoveries have continued over the past decade. In 2023, archaeologists discovered a 1200-year-old Wari ritual complex in Arequipa. While more discoveries are being made regarding the Wari Empire, archaeologists are able to draw more conclusions about the Wari Empire's culture.

Woodland period#Early Woodland period (1.headline: Zgodnje gozdno obdobje
paragraphs: Zgodnje gozdno obdobje (Early Woodland) je nadaljevalo številne težnje, ki so se začele v poznem in končnem arhaičnem obdobju: obsežno gradnjo gomil, regionalno značilne pogrebne komplekse, trgovino z eksotičnim blagom na velikem delu Severne Amerike v okviru t. i. interakcijskih sfer, prehrano iz divjih in udomačenih rastlin ter mobilno preživetje, pri katerem so manjše skupine izkoriščale sezonske vire, kot so oreški, ribe, školjke in divje rastline. Lončenina, ki so jo v arhaičnem obdobju izdelovali le v omejenih količinah, se je zdaj razširila po vsem vzhodnem notranjem delu, jugovzhodu in severovzhodu. Skrajni severovzhod, subarktika ter severozahod in Velike planjave so jo na splošno prevzeli nekoliko pozneje, okoli leta 200 pr. n. št.
notes: Woodland period rendered as gozdno obdobje with the English term at first mention; no established Slovenian term was found.

source.title: Woodland period
